title: A Varifold-Based Score for Decoupling Deformations in Shape Analysis
summary: In computational anatomy, analyzing morphological variability across shape populations often requires multi-component deformation models that combine structured motions and unconstrained diffeomorphisms. However, a major challenge arises during the registration process, as high-dimensional deformations tend to absorb lower-dimensional components, altering the true geometric variability and preventing accurate statistical analysis.
